title.ko: 정보주체와 법정대리인의 권리·의무 및 행사방법에 관한 사항
title.en: Rights of data subjects and legal representatives

rules.element: core rights and how to exercise
rules.statement: State the rights and duties of data subjects and legal representatives and, concretely, how and through which procedure to exercise access, correction or deletion, processing suspension and consent withdrawal. The procedure must not be harder than the collection channel. A stated membership-withdrawal (회원 탈퇴) path counts as a consent-withdrawal procedure.

If a website is operated, explain in plain terms how to use its self-service functions for access, correction, deletion and consent withdrawal (e.g. member info view/edit, withdrawal, consent withdrawal menus). Transmission requests belong to R-S16-005 (only for transmitters).
Procedures reflect actual operations and are not harder than the way data was collected.
Offer a downloadable request form and state the department and contact that receives requests (may be the S18 privacy department).

If the processor is an information transmitter under Decree 42-2, state how to request transmission to oneself and how to check transmission status and history; for third-party transmission, say it is requested via the recipient's service and that recipient lists and request status are on the national transmission support platform.
rules.effectiveNote: Decree 42-2(1)1 (large private processors) in force 2027-02-20 (verified 2026-10-02, MST 289537); items 2-3 already in force.

rules.element: agents, limits, identity check, response time
rules.statement: Cover exercise through a legal representative or agent (with power of attorney), statutory limits on access and suspension, no deletion where another law requires the data, identity verification, and the response period.
Children under 14 exercise rights through the legal representative; minors 14 or older may act themselves or through the representative.

Where the processor makes fully automated decisions (PIPA 37-2), list refusal and explanation requests among the rights and point to the S17 section for the method; where none are made, a short statement that none are made is recommended.

rules.element: consent withdrawal named as a right
rules.statement: Name consent withdrawal as a right of the data subject, not only as membership withdrawal (PIPA 37(1)).

goodPatterns: Numbered clauses: rights list; channels (writing, phone, e-mail, fax, internet) with actual menu paths; optional transmission and third-party transmission lines; automated-decision request path; agent with power-of-attorney form; statutory limits; identity check; receiving department and contact with reply within 10 days (transmission without delay) as in the example.

commonDefects.defect: Only 'contact us' given; no self-service path although a website/app exists.
Withdrawal or deletion requires a harder route (e.g. visit or mail) than sign-up (online).
Response period stated inconsistently with the operator's real process.

extractionHints: menu names: 내 정보, 회원정보, 탈퇴, 동의 철회
